name: Ranger Titan Hunter
body:
Massive creatures are bane on the existence of the more diminutive folk of the world. Certain guards of the borderlands train to thwart the size benefits of the terrifying creatures of those outlands.

Leg Dodger (Ex)

At 2nd level, the titan hunter gains a +2 dodge bonus to their AC against creatures that are two size categories or more larger than them. This bonus increases to use their favored enemy value if higher.

This ability replaces the combat style feat gained at 2nd level.

Slippery (Ex)

At 3rd level, the titan hunter is adept at escaping the grasp of larger foes. If they are grappled by a creature at least two size categories higher than themselves, they add 1/2 their class level to any checks made to escape the grapple. This bonus also applies to Acrobatics checks against such creatures.

This ability replaces endurance.

Close Shot (Ex)

At 6th level, the titan hunter does not provoke attacks of opportunity using ranged attacks against creatures at least one size category larger than themselves.

This ability replaces the combat style feat gained at 6th level.

Defensive Roll (Ex)

At 14th level, the titan hunter gains defensive roll, as the rogue talent of the same name.

This ability replaces the combat style feat gained at 14th level.
